---
title: "Report a problem or request data"
---

Found a corrupted file, inconsistent variable names, missing time steps, or a
dataset you need that is not here? Tell us.

## With a GitHub account

- [Report a problem with a dataset](https://github.com/{{< var github_repo >}}/issues/new?template=report-problem.yml)
- [Request data](https://github.com/{{< var github_repo >}}/issues/new?template=data-request.yml)

Every row in the [browser](browse.qmd) has a **Report** link that fills in
the dataset id for you. Issues are public: do not include passwords or
anything private.

## Without a GitHub account

Email [{{< var help_email >}}](mailto:{{< var help_email >}}) with the dataset
id or file path, what you were doing, and what went wrong (or, for requests:
variable, experiment, model, frequency, and why you need it). We will open an
issue for you without publishing your email address.
